questionSource.excerpt: Shall Option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?
questionSource.fullSourceCell: Shall Option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?    Minnesota Statutes, sections 367.30 and 367.31 provide for optional forms of town government and one of the options (Option B) allows the Town to seek the transition of treasurer position from an elected office to an appointed office

resolutionSource.visualReview: Complete page viewed; bounded resolution heading/body/adoption date transcribed, no claim to transcribe handwritten signatures.

whatItDoes.quote:
WHEREAS, Minn. Stat. §367.30 provides towns the option to change from an
elected Clerk to an appointed Clerk as Option B under such statute; and

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Town Board of Clearwater
Township, Wright County, Minnesota does hereby designate that the Township Clerk
shall hereafter be appointed by the Town Board, provided that the electors vote to
authorize the adoption of said Option B at the November 3, 2026 Town election.
